issues.description: The required student-count attribute names are inconsistent within the problem statement: Part 1 instructs students to add attributes `inscribedStudents` and `guestStudents`, but the UML diagram (and corresponding intended API implied by later getter/setter test names) uses `numberOfInscribedStudents` and `numberOfGuestStudents`. This can lead students to implement differently named fields and therefore mismatching getter/setter names expected by tests.
issues.suggestedFix: In Part 1, replace `inscribedStudents` and `guestStudents` with the exact UML names `numberOfInscribedStudents` and `numberOfGuestStudents` so the narrative and UML match the required identifiers.
